chapter_seo_title: Li Huowang’s Desperate Bluff & Yang Na’s Return – Chapter 500
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang scares off the Bureau with a forced hallucination—only to collapse back into a cold prison yard where his mother’s tears and Yang Na’s frail silhouette tear his mind apart.
og_title: When Forcing the Fake Costs Everything
og_description: A split-second bluff saves Li Huowang from the Bureau—but the backlash drags him back to a prison yard, his mother’s grief, and Yang Na’s heartbroken face.
twitter_title: Li Huowang’s Reality Just Shattered Again
twitter_description: Forcing Zhuge Yuan’s ghost into existence was a gamble that worked—but the price is a shattered Primordial Qi and the unbearable sight of Yang Na crying behind an iron fence.

lore_anchors.definition: The original, undifferentiated life-force that exists before the separation of yin and yang in Daoist cosmology; destabilizing it causes severe physical and spiritual backlash.
A Heart-Element’s ability to solidify a hallucination into a temporary physical form; overuse destabilizes the user’s internal energy and causes bodily swelling or pain.
A weapon made from Zhuge Yuan’s skull and marrow; it functions as a spiritual anchor that lowers the cost of manifesting Zhuge Yuan’s hallucination into reality.
Government-sponsored supernatural law enforcement in the Dao-Twisted World; they track rogue cultivators and are deeply afraid of Zhuge Yuan’s power.
A confined outdoor area under iron mesh used for psychiatric patients deemed a danger; the setting reinforces Li Huowang’s loss of freedom and his mother’s desperation.
Li Huowang’s mother; she has aged visibly under the stress of his condition and bears the weight of his suffering with silent, tearful endurance.
Li Huowang’s girlfriend in the modern world; she has become emaciated and heartbroken, torn between her love for him and her family’s pressure to move on.
